title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Repair Coverage Switches and Allowances by Tier
content:
## Coverage determination table

The service coordinator reads a repair on a covered unit under the Preventive Maintenance Agreements against the switches and figures of the agreement's tier set out here. Each row is one tier; each column is one published coverage element.

| Tier | Repair labor on covered equipment included | Repair parts on covered equipment included | Compressor replacement a covered repair | Heat exchanger replacement a covered repair | Pounds of refrigerant per year included before refrigerant is billed | Annual cap on covered repair value the agreement absorbs per term (USD; 0 means no repair coverage) | Amount billed per covered repair applied (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Filter & Belt Service Plan | no | no | no | no | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Inspection Agreement | no | no | no | no | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Preventive Maintenance Agreement | no | no | no | no | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Labor Coverage Agreement | yes | no | no | no | 10 | 4800 | 0 |
| Full Coverage Agreement | yes | yes | no | no | 25 | 12500 | 250 |
| Comprehensive Performance Agreement | yes | yes | yes | yes | 60 | 32000 | 0 |

### Notes to the table

1. An annual repair allowance of 0 means the tier carries no repair coverage at all; that is the position at the Filter & Belt Service Plan, the Inspection Agreement and the Preventive Maintenance Agreement.
2. The Labor Coverage Agreement covers repair labor but not parts, with an allowance of 4800 USD per term and 10 pounds of included refrigerant.
3. The Full Coverage Agreement covers both labor and parts, with an allowance of 12500 USD per term, 25 pounds of included refrigerant and a deductible of 250 USD billed per covered repair applied.
4. Compressor replacement and heat exchanger replacement are covered repairs at the Comprehensive Performance Agreement only, which also carries the largest allowance, 32000 USD per term, 60 pounds of included refrigerant and no deductible.

### Determination examples (hypothetical)

- A hypothetical compressor replacement on a unit covered by a Full Coverage Agreement: the compressor switch at that tier is "no", so the compressor is not a covered repair at that tier, whatever the parts switch says.
- A hypothetical repair on a unit covered by a Labor Coverage Agreement: the labor switch is "yes" and the parts switch is "no", so the labor element is the covered element and the deductible per covered repair is 0.
